selection_policy: Explicit representative anchors selected and frozen before any model experiment, across actual feature kinds. Deterministic inventory sorted by symbol; this binding is curated, not claimed to be a random sample. No post-result replacement.
capability_evidence: javac-facts.json.gz and not-applicable.json; all 50 IDs accounted for
generated_freshness: Captured build artifacts are independent supplementary snapshot evidence; source/compiled consistency checked by javac attribution, not a fresh full augmentation. A paid runner must additionally establish native index readiness and full build-input alignment.
runtime_oracle_limits: No application/container startup. Static applicability and known conditional rules are scored; actual request authorization, network calls, transactional commit and async context propagation remain explicitly unproven.
readiness: offline_oracles_prepared; not authorization or claim that a model experiment ran
required_before_paid_run: isolate private oracles/helpers from model filesystem
verify current compiled/native readiness against pinned inputs
independent session/cache-stratum preflight and frozen schedule
